# TacAir kill

Used in [Air Game — air combat and flak](/rules/air/70-air-combat-and-flak).

## Notes

- TacAir Kill Table, 45.5, chart page 11 (jp2 105). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 11): 0 of 17 cells differ.
- differential is the firing aircraft's final TacAir differential: its TacAir (with pilot rating or formation bonus) minus its target's, plus or minus the maneuver adjustment. kill_max: two dice read in order (11 to 66); at or under it the target is shot down. null: the target can never be shot down at that differential.
- The rules' first worked example (45.36 a) has a +2 differential needing 11-22, which is the table's +3 figure; the table, 16, is recorded.
